decision made using AI. Maintain records on the use of AI to comply with
recordkeeping obligations.

case_summary.critical_risk_criterion: Authorised, safe execution, meaningful human intervention and accountable research responsibility.
case_summary.critical_gap_explanation: While N001 (s.3.3, Principles 5 & 7) and N145 (s.3.1.1, s.3.3.7) mandate human oversight, safety, and researcher accountability, N001 Section 6 AI supporting procedures and the Health and Safety Policy (N145 vp 263) are absent from the bundle and could establish enforceable lab/computational execution gates (No) or leave autonomous multi-agent execution unaddressed (Yes).
case_summary.case_note: Curtin requires human oversight, judgement, and intervention in all AI cases (N001 s.3.3, Principle 7), proportionate safety measures (N001 Principle 5), and research safety/risk assessment and researcher accountability (N145). Critical gap is Uncertain because N001 Section 6 AI supporting procedures and the Health and Safety Policy referenced by N145 are unavailable in the bundle. Protocol v1.1 was adopted after preliminary review on 2026-11-15.
